Class Snake

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.Snake
public class Snake extends Object
Stores snake positions and applies movement, growth and collision rules. Sprite views are loaded lazily when requested by the renderer.

  • Constructor Details

    • Snake

      public Snake(int x, int y, boolean noBorder, Obstacle obstacle)
      Creates a left-facing two-cell snake at the board centre.
      Parameters:
      x - board width in cells
      y - board height in cells
      noBorder - whether permanent border wrapping is enabled
      obstacle - collision-cell provider

  • Method Details

    • move

      public boolean move(char dir, Point coinPosition)
      Attempts one complete movement step, including growth and collision checks. A fatal step marks the snake dead but preserves its last valid positions and sprite direction. Calls after death leave all state unchanged.
      Parameters:
      dir - U, D, L or R
      coinPosition - the coin cell, or null when no coin is present
      Returns:
      true only when a successful move collects the coin
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a living snake receives an invalid direction

    • move

      boolean move(char dir, Point coinPosition, boolean growOnPickup)
      Moves one cell with optional growth when a pickup is collected.
      Parameters:
      dir - U, D, L or R
      coinPosition - pickup cell, or null when no pickup is present
      growOnPickup - whether collection retains the old tail cell
      Returns:
      true only when a successful move collects the pickup
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a living snake receives an unknown direction

    • findRespawn

      void findRespawn(Point coin)
      Places a left-facing two-cell snake on the nearest clear lane to the centre.
      Parameters:
      coin - pickup cell to avoid, or null
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no safe three-cell lane exists

    • findRespawn

      void findRespawn(Point coin, char direction)
      Places and orients a two-cell snake with a clear first step; does not clear the death flag.
      Parameters:
      coin - pickup cell to avoid, or null
      direction - U, D, L or R for the first movement
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if direction is unknown
      IllegalStateException - if no safe three-cell lane exists
